name: Valencian hand fan (abanico)
about: A folding fan that reflects Valencia's traditional craft. It is a classic souvenir from the city.
tip: Check that it is made in Spain and that the frame is wood.

name: Paella rice and kit
about: Bomba-style rice is the base of paella, the dish Valencia is famous for. Buying it here brings a taste of the city home.
tip: Ask the stall to confirm the rice type before you pay, since not all rice is suited to paella.

name: Lladró porcelain
about: Lladró is a porcelain brand founded near Valencia. Its figurines are known around the world.
tip: Choose a small or medium piece to keep the price and packing manageable.
